newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 1.218 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 1.218 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was seeking to buy 1,218,000 lbs of frozen beef, special trim, for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal food assistance programs.

All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-48 and be received by 1430 EST in Washington, D.C., on Friday, December 20, 1996. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, December 27, 1996.
Deliveries for beef, special trim are to be made between January 20 and January 31, 1997.
